I used a logistic regression and a random forest on the tabular data. I created a train test split and also ran cross-validation to check stability. A majority-class baseline gave 0.62 accuracy, so I report precision, recall and F1 because the classes are imbalanced. I checked for leakage by removing the ID column and fitting the scaler only on the training split, which also guards against overfitting.
## Evaluation
Random forest reached F1 0.71 against the baseline.
